exposure: Type of operating room (General surgery, Curettage, Eye surgery, Neurosurgery, Orthopedic, Laparoscopic, Cesarean, and Ear, nose, throat)
cohort: Personnel and surgical staff in eight operating rooms in hospitals of Sabzevar, Iran
finding: Concentrations of BTEX compounds varied significantly across different operating rooms, with benzene posing a carcinogenic risk to personnel and surgical staff in all operating rooms.
